sampling: One fresh process per RESYNC mode, three identical 16K/512 requests. First request is warm-up; two subsequent transitions per mode. Send immediately after DONE, before metrics I/O; timer starts before write/flush. Final post-DONE resync drains before QUIT. Six primary requests, with one conditional three-request 2-ms-gap probe if both immediate transitions stop before any promotions. Historical v1.3.99/v1.3.101 smoke is a previously collected reference, not a simultaneous randomized version A/B.
limitations: Interruption smoke only, not a repeated 16K/2K performance comparison or a full-model accuracy test. No new numerical CHECK run. Output IDs may differ across modes or repeated processes. Startup tier records included; no dedicated startup investigation.
